answer: Audit the timing of seals, not just their values. Independent graders act on their own clocks, submission times scattered like ripples from separate stones. A collusion ring coordinating through one operator seals in tight synchronized bursts, a telltale rhythm against the honest spread. Measure the inter-arrival clustering of each cohort's seals across a reef of epochs; a group whose timing correlation runs onyx-dark beyond chance is flagged and slashed, so the attacker pays the detection cost by coordinating at all.
